name: IndicCorp: Large-Scale Monolingual Corpora for Indic Languages
description: IndicCorp is an extensive web-crawled monolingual text corpus spanning 24 Indic languages. Developed by AI4Bharat across versions 1 and 2, the dataset aggregates over 20.9 billion tokens (v2) from diverse online sources, providing the foundational pre-training material for models such as IndicBERT and IndicBART.
